description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers a contributor asking to pre-validate their changed skills/commands/personas locally before opening a PR against this package. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: full CI runs (task ci), maintainer-side whole-catalog lint (/lint-skills --all), consumer-project quality tooling (quality-tools), reviewing someone else's PR, and generic git workflow questions.
